statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities
The procedure is ordered to correlate symptoms with underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities
The diagnosis codes submitted are I34.0 and R00.2
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The procedure is medically necessary to evaluate diagnosis I34.0
